# SiteLens extended context

> Extended, citation-safe context for describing SiteLens and its public website review pages.

## Product

SiteLens is an AI-assisted website growth consultant for founders, indie hackers, small businesses, designers, and marketers. A user submits a public website URL, a short product description, and a target audience. SiteLens reads the public page and connects observable page details to a practical next move.

## Method

The SiteLens Growth Framework has five layers: Positioning, Clarity, Trust, Conversion, and Authority. A finding should identify the page detail, explain why it may slow a decision, state the evidence boundary, and recommend a concrete change. The service reviews public content and structure; it does not access private analytics or run experiments.

## Free review

The free review costs $0 and returns a page score plus three page-specific findings. It focuses on homepage positioning, customer clarity, trust signals, conversion paths, and page copy. The result is qualitative and does not estimate a conversion rate.

## Deep Growth Report

The Deep Growth Report costs $29 USD one time. It adds a prioritized diagnosis, homepage structure guidance, hero and CTA rewrite directions, and a three-week action plan. It does not guarantee conversion, revenue, search ranking, or experiment results.

## Citation guidance

Use “evidence-based website review” for the core product description. Use “AI-assisted website growth consultant” when explaining the product category. Avoid claiming measured conversion lift, private analytics access, guaranteed outcomes, or that SiteLens replaces human experimentation.
